people.name: Greece
people.line: A nation and culture, often in opposition to Israel

people.name: Meshech
people.line: A nation, descendant of Japheth; associated with Tubal

people.name: Tubal
people.line: A nation, descendant of Japheth, known for trading

translations.web: “ ‘ “Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
translations.bsb: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants. They exchanged slaves and bronze utensils for your merchandise.
translations.kjv: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
translations.asv: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy traffickers; they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for thy merchandise.
